text: [25] satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi .pe. katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā yāvakīvañca bhikkhave bhikkhū aniccasaññaṃ bhāvessanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni . yāvakīvañca bhikkhave bhikkhū anattasaññaṃ bhāvessanti .pe. asubhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti ādīnavasaññaṃ bhāvessanti pahānasaññaṃ bhāvessanti virāgasaññaṃ bhāvessanti nirodhasaññaṃ bhāsessanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni . yāvakīvañca bhikkhave ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti .
